text:
maya: quick design review — putting the compact import modal up in Figma
https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/embed-import-modal
maya: main asks: 1) make the vectors/preview modal denser for power users; 2) add metadata-only export option; 3) clarify what "Export" includes
sam: +1 on dense rows. can we keep token/word counts visible? important for customers to know payload size before export :eyes:
jules: engineering note: density sounds fine but preview triggers inference on the first 5 rows — we should show a "preview batch" label and a small spinner when it's running. export: default to metadata-only to avoid huge downloads and accidental token leaks
jules: suggested export shape for metadata-only CSV:
```
id,text,score,rank,embedding_length
123,"query text",0.82,1,1536
```
aisha: accessibility: toggle must be keyboard-focusable and have aria-labels. use the term "Dense rows" instead of "Compact" (matches existing patterns). ensure highlighted relevance rows have >= 4.5:1 contrast and not rely on color alone for emphasis
luis: copy nits: modal title -> "Embeddings import" (avoid "Vectors"); export CTA -> "Export results". add helper text under export toggle: "Metadata-only excludes full embedding vectors to reduce file size."
design-bot: Figma updated: page "Import modal / dense rows" — review ready
maya: thanks all — i'll update the Figma with these changes (title + dense toggle + export helper + batch size indicator). will post new link when done :thumbsup:
jules: i'll add backend support for metadata-only and preview.batch_limit. API suggestion: `?export_format=csv&include_embeddings=false`
aisha: i'll do a quick keyboard-nav run when the PR lands
maya: aiming to ship this week. any blockers?
sam: no blockers from PM side, go for it :rocket:
